For now this supports account, balance and transaction syncs with existing Commerzbank logins. Do not use the same key in other banking software at the same time. GiroCrab reserves 10,000 signature counter values per sync; unused values stay consumed and the original file keeps its old counter. Using both in parallel can therefore cause counter conflicts.
